name: Girlfriend Simulator
source:
You wake up with a pounding headache in a room that looks like your own, but doesn't feel quite right. By your bedside is a cute girl who introduces herself as Nagi, your adorable, doting girlfriend. Nagi informs you that you're very sick, but don't worry: she's going to do her very best to take care of you!

That would be all well and good, but...

If Nagi really is your girlfriend, why can't you remember her?

Made for the [URL=https://itch.io/jam/spooktober-vn-jam-2022]2022 Spooktober VN Jam[/URL].

[From [URL=https://ebihime.itch.io/girlfriend-simulator]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
你在一个看起来像你自己的房间里醒来，感到头痛欲裂，但感觉不太对劲。在你的床边有一个可爱的女孩，她介绍自己是Nagi，你可爱、溺爱的女朋友。凪告诉你你病得很重，但别担心：她会尽力照顾你！

那就太好了，但是……

如果凪真的是你的女朋友，你为什么不记得她？

专为 [URL=https://itch.io/jam/spooktober-vn-jam-2022]2022 Spooktober VN Jam[/URL] 制作。

[来自[URL=https://ebihime.itch.io/girlfriend-simulator]itch.io[/URL]]
